description: SvGrid Base as the <sv-base> custom element, for React, Vue, Angular or a plain HTML page. Plain DOM code creates the element, assigns tables, users and currentUser as properties and listens to tableschange, which carries the whole list after every edit; the log shows each event. The code block is the same page written with a script tag and no build step.

faq.question: Which properties and events does <sv-base> have?
faq.answer: Properties: tables (or data, columns and views for one table), users, currentUser and options for any other SvBase prop. Attributes: height, editable, sortable, show-row-numbers, column-adder, field-menu, expand-rows, active-table and license-key, among others. Events: tableschange with the whole list, ready with the grid api, viewschange and remotechange.

faq.question: Does it use a shadow root?
faq.answer: No. Like <sv-sheet>, it renders in the light DOM, so its menus, dialogs and toasts can open over the page and the --sg-* theme tokens reach it from the page's CSS.

faq.question: How is it licensed?
faq.answer: It is part of SvGrid Base, in the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Set the license-key attribute or the licenseKey property; without a key it runs with a watermark.
